Definition: middle voice from G356; to estimate, i.e. (figuratively) contemplate:--consider.
BiblicalUsage: The word appears once: 'For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.' It is the act of weighing something up, turning it over in the mind — and the thing to consider is Christ, enduring the contradiction of sinners so that we do not grow weary.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for considering carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the looking — consider Him, and you will not faint.
